description_for_human: Find and use community-approved AI prompt templates (skills). Resolve the best skill for any task, list your org's skills, or submit new ones.
description_for_model: SkillMesh is a shared library of approved AI prompt templates called skills. Use findPublicSkill (GET /public/p?q=...) for open access — returns plain text in the format: skill name, description, then the prompt template, separated by newlines. Fill in any {{variable}} placeholders before using the template. Use resolve_skill for authenticated vector search with private skills.
